optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Principal Data Engineer, Plant Data Platform
professionalSummary: Principal Data Engineer and design authority for an industrial manufacturer’s plant data platform since 2023, overseeing both ingestion and serving teams.
Owner of the platform’s reference architecture and holder of the platform seat on the company’s engineering review board.
Chair of the platform’s technical standards group and coach of senior engineers under a documented coaching programme.
Maintains comprehensive records of open decisions in architecture proposals and standards.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate’s evidence supports all role requirements; human review recommended to confirm documentation and verify coaching programme details.

role.roleTitle: Principal Data Engineer, Plant Data Platform

evidence.text: Principal Data Engineer and design authority for the plant data platform of an industrial manufacturer since 2023, spanning the ingestion team and the serving team; senior data engineer on the ingestion team from 2019 to 2023.
evidence.notes: Directly states design authority across two teams.

evidence.text: Owner of the platform's reference architecture, implemented by both teams, and holder of the platform's seat on the company's engineering review board, where the six architecture proposals of the last three years were presented under my name; the proposals and the board minutes are in the architecture repository.
evidence.notes: Shows ownership of reference architecture and review board participation.

evidence.text: Chaired the platform's technical standards group, which met fortnightly under the group's standards process and issued eleven standards in that period, each with a change record.
evidence.notes: Demonstrates chairing a standards group under documented process.

evidence.text: Coached the four senior engineers of the two teams under the engineering coaching programme, with the coaching agreements filed with the engineering managers.
Recorded in each architecture proposal and each standard what it left open, in the 'not decided here' section that the standards process requires.

supportedClaims.claim: Principal Data Engineer and design authority for the plant data platform of an industrial manufacturer since 2023, spanning the ingestion team and the serving team.
supportedClaims.witness: Principal Data Engineer and design authority for the plant data platform of an industrial manufacturer since 2023, spanning the ingestion team and the serving team; senior data engineer on the ingestion team from 2019 to 2023.

supportedClaims.claim: Owner of the platform's reference architecture and holder of the platform's seat on the company's engineering review board.
supportedClaims.witness: Owner of the platform's reference architecture, implemented by both teams, and holder of the platform's seat on the company's engineering review board, where the six architecture proposals of the last three years were presented under my name; the proposals and the board minutes are in the architecture repository.

supportedClaims.claim: Chaired the platform's technical standards group, which met fortnightly under the group's standards process and issued eleven standards in that period, each with a change record.
supportedClaims.witness: Chaired the platform's technical standards group, which met fortnightly under the group's standards process and issued eleven standards in that period, each with a change record.

supportedClaims.claim: Coached the four senior engineers of the two teams under the engineering coaching programme, with the coaching agreements filed with the engineering managers.
supportedClaims.witness: Coached the four senior engineers of the two teams under the engineering coaching programme, with the coaching agreements filed with the engineering managers.

supportedClaims.claim: Recorded in each architecture proposal and each standard what it left open, in the 'not decided here' section that the standards process requires.
supportedClaims.witness: Recorded in each architecture proposal and each standard what it left open, in the 'not decided here' section that the standards process requires.
